precepts.point: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? Prudent, and he shall know them? For the ways of the Lord are right, and the just shall walk in them, but the transgressors shall fall therein.

note.label: Hosea 14: O Israel, Return Unto the Lord

precepts.why: “for the ways of the Lord are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.” Christ gives the same warning: “except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.” The transgressors shall fall, and except we repent we perish. Who is wise, and he shall understand these things.

note.label: Hosea 14: O Israel, Return Unto the Lord

precepts.why:
Hosea asks “Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them?” The just walk in the ways of the Lord, but the transgressors fall therein. David’s words are a prayer for the last days: “Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults. Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.”

That is the prayer for us: that the Lord cleanse us from secret faults and keep us back from presumptuous sins, that they not have dominion over us, so we be upright and innocent from the great transgression, walking in his ways rather than falling in them.

points: O Israel, return unto the Lord thy God, for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.

note.label: Hosea 14: O Israel, Return Unto the Lord

points: Take with you words and turn to the Lord; say unto him, Take away all iniquity and receive us graciously, so will we render the calves of our lips.

note.label: Hosea 14: O Israel, Return Unto the Lord

points: Asshur shall not save us, we will not ride upon horses, neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, Ye are our gods, for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy. This is going into the northern kingdom repenting from idolatry.

note.label: Hosea 14: O Israel, Return Unto the Lord

points: He will heal their backsliding and love them freely, for his anger is turned away from him.

note.label: Hosea 14: O Israel, Return Unto the Lord

points: He will be as the dew unto Israel; he shall grow as the lily and cast forth his roots as Lebanon. His branches shall spread, his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.

note.label: Hosea 14: O Israel, Return Unto the Lord

points: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn and grow as the vine, and the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.

note.label: Hosea 14: O Israel, Return Unto the Lord

points: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? The Most High has heard him and observed him; he is like a green fir tree, and from him is thy fruit found. There it is, a future prophecy of when Ephraim is freed of his idolatry; this is the ten tribes in the last hour coming to the fold, and we are getting close.
